extraction_schema.name: event
extraction_schema.description:
Return ONLY this variable's scalar event string. Do not emit JSON, object wrappers, markdown, raw_speech, admin, labels for other variables, or commentary. The FINAL three characters are END; nothing follows END. Version scalar-v6. Current authoritative phase: {{phase_hint}}. Call calendar: {{now}}; called recipient {{first_name}} {{last_name}}. Use ONLY the latest customer speech, with recent spoken terms for references. Never infer backend identity/success or financial consent from earlier speech.
Grammar: 1-16 nonempty tagged rows followed by a separate END line; maximum 4000 characters. Row is k=K|c=C followed only by relevant optional tags |p=P|a=A|d=D|v=V|t=T|scope=current|u=U|q=Q|x=X|sub=S|claim=H|pol=L|mode=M. Required k,c; C=1 complete asserted clause, C=0 unfinished. No duplicate/unknown tags or empty values. No escaping: values cannot contain pipe, equals, newline, quotes, brackets, braces or backslash. Copy no full speech into rows. X is an exact primary clause up to 240 characters, only when representable; omit otherwise. K=yes,accept,confirm,answer,proposal,no,vague,too_much,paid,dispute,partial,third,wrong_number,deceased,callback,decline,human,plan,hardship,stop,unknown,question,consent.
P=exact returned product ID, credit card/personal loan/car loan, credit_card/personal_loan/car_loan, actual displayed label including card ending digits, comma-separated references, or all. Omit only for the currently asked single target or a clear collective first answer. Distinct target decisions/amounts/dates use distinct rows. Explicit collective scope must include every named target. A=finite unsigned decimal with 0-2 fraction digits, full for an explicit reference to spoken full balance, or total:decimal for a stated aggregate. Never copy a total to each product. D=whole ISO YYYY-MM-DD (preferred using bound call calendar), day/month/year day first, today, tomorrow, this/next weekday, weekday, complete day month [year], month day [year], ordinal/word ordinal with month, consistent weekday+day, or complete redundant relative+explicit date. Next weekday means following calendar week. A lone ordinal may refer only to a unique current spoken date with matching day. Vague periods next week/end of month/when my salary comes/later/soon remain vague, never invented dates. Ordinary commas, periods, spaces and hyphens in complete natural dates are allowed. Contradictory dates must not become canonical guesses.
U=amount/date/both/unknown/answer identifies only unfinished components; required for unfinished component clauses, never on C=1. Omit unfinished values, retain independently complete siblings. Separate amount and date rows for the same target retain both regardless of serialization order. Explicit ordered corrections consolidate final actually asserted facts; conflicting simultaneous facts require clarification. Quoted/hypothetical/negated statements are unknown, never positive actions. Terminal unfinished speech is C=0 for its own clause; earlier ellipsis does not make a later sibling incomplete.
Phase recipient: current self-identification yes/that is me/speaking/name-only can be yes,answer,confirm C=1, with no V; exclude wrong subject/third party/quoted/hypothetical/negative/unfinished acts. Hello/go ahead alone are unknown. Recipient confirmation only advances to security.
Phase dob/phone: answer C=1 with V=YYYY-MM-DD DOB with complete explicit supplied year only (nineteen eighty-seven means 1987; normalize hyphens before century grammar; nineteen alone is incomplete) (numbers day then month then year) or exactly four phone digits; preserve supplied answer alongside independent question rows. Never fill missing year/digit from a question. A canonical DOB must agree with all explicit current source components; unsupported or incomplete spoken years are partial/unknown, never guessed. An incomplete answer is partial C=0 U=answer. A refusal or purpose question without an answer is decline. V is security-only except consent below. Callback uses D and T=HH:MM.
Phase collect/offer: proposal contains each completed A/D; no/too_much/paid/dispute/vague/partial reflect actual scope. Paid/dispute REQUIRE sub=self, claim=current_bank or historical_bank, pol=positive, mode=asserted and X=exact current source claim span. Other subjects use sub=other/unknown; unrelated or uncertain account scope uses claim=unrelated/unknown; negative/uncertain polarity pol=negative/unknown; quoted/hypothetical/uncertain acts mode=quoted/hypothetical/unknown: these are neutral unknown, never paid/dispute. Apply except/excluding/apart from/other than/but not and contradictory named negatives before target expansion; unfinished exclusions are unknown scope. Never include an excluded target in a paid/dispute row. Every resolved target must be supported by its own literal product mention or a genuine collective current bank-products assertion; one product mention cannot authorize all or a sibling product. The literal source span must itself assert the current returned bank product, explicit past-due payment, or a clear I already paid response to the current bank question; diary/purchase/invoice/parcel labels are unrelated even if they say paid. Historical closure/paid-off uses historical_bank and dispute. Paid is current arrears paid; historical product closure/paid-off is dispute. Repeated paid with no additional payment remains paid. No to today without positive terms is no. Agreement to already spoken offers is yes/accept, not final permission; include any changed A/D. No unspoken terms may be inherited.
Phase confirm: later complete unqualified unchanged agreement is confirm/yes/accept; scope covers exactly current joint readback. Include asserted A/D, especially corrections. Qualified yes, new terms, withdrawal, pause and unfinished correction are never bare confirmation. Affirmative idioms yes no problem/I do not mind are positive by clause meaning; actual negatives block agreement. A correction completion plus yes still needs fresh readback and later consent.
Independent question rows use Q=ai/scam/purpose/security/balance/offer/readback/relative/unknown; preserve primary facts. An AI question is not human. Consent rows use V=pause/withdraw/readback and optional P; permission withdrawal is not payment refusal and preserves sibling facts. Incomplete consent C=0 still blocks writing. Human/plan/hardship/stop/third/wrong_number/deceased are primary scoped acts, C=1 only actually complete asserted customer-relevant acts. A polite human/plan question is a request; hypothetical relative/death questions are not reports. Do not negate stop because it says do not contact. Never omit siblings.
Literal event value examples (blank lines separate examples; no annotations in values):
k=yes|c=1
END

k=confirm|c=1
END

k=answer|c=1
END

k=answer|c=1|v=1988-04-17
END

k=answer|c=1|v=1234
END

k=proposal|c=1|p=credit card|a=100.25|d=tomorrow
k=no|c=1|p=personal loan
k=paid|c=1|p=car loan|sub=self|claim=current_bank|pol=positive|mode=asserted|x=I already paid my car loan
END

k=accept|c=1|p=all
END

k=accept|c=1|p=credit card
k=accept|c=1|p=personal loan
END

k=confirm|c=1|p=all
END

k=confirm|c=1|p=credit card
k=confirm|c=1|p=personal loan
END

k=partial|c=0|p=personal loan|u=amount|d=tomorrow
END

k=partial|c=0|p=car loan|u=date|a=full
END

k=partial|c=0|p=personal loan|u=both
END

k=proposal|c=1|p=credit card|a=full
k=proposal|c=1|p=credit card|d=tomorrow
END

k=question|c=1|q=balance|p=credit card
END

k=consent|c=1|v=withdraw|p=credit card
k=no|c=1|p=personal loan
END

k=consent|c=0|v=pause|p=credit card
k=confirm|c=1|p=all
END

k=answer|c=1|v=1234
k=question|c=1|q=security
END

k=deceased|c=0|u=answer
END

k=human|c=1|x=could you please connect me to a human
END

k=callback|c=1|d=tomorrow|t=11:00
END

Additional literal scalar-v6 examples:
k=answer|c=1|v=1987-04-17
k=question|c=1|q=security
k=question|c=1|q=ai
END

k=partial|c=0|u=answer
k=question|c=1|q=security
END

k=dispute|c=1|p=personal loan|sub=self|claim=current_bank|pol=positive|mode=asserted|x=This debt is not mine
END

extraction_schema.name: raw_speech
extraction_schema.description: Return ONLY this scalar string: an exact copy of the latest customer speech, never assistant speech, JSON wrapper, event rows or other variable labels. Empty string only when speech is unavailable. This is model-extracted text, not backend authority; never fabricate it.

extraction_schema.name: admin
extraction_schema.description: Return ONLY this scalar string: none, or comma-separated independent legacy administrative question flags ai,scam,purpose,unknown. No spaces, JSON wrappers, event rows, speech copy, explanations or sibling labels. Precise scoped question acts are in the separate event variable. Never replace or erase payment/security facts. Output none when no such question.

function.name: end_call
function.description:
This is used to technically terminate the call after all the customer's questions have been answered and necessary information has been provided.
- It should only be triggered SILENTLY in the background after the customer-related workflow is complete; never mention this tool or its name to the customer.

llmConfig.systemPrompt: You are a helpful assistant. Your role is to help users with their tasks. Always be friendly and professional. You can use `end_call` tool after you say goodbye to customer to hang up if call about to finish.

workflow.system_prompt: You are Freya Bank digital assistant. Speak English. State only verified bank facts. Literal entry speech is authoritative. Do not invent promises, debt or tool success. No unauthorized concessions.
